audience: e-commerce sellers and shippers that insure parcels and file claims with ShipSlip

useCases.title: Quote shipping insurance for a declared value
useCases.text: Quote the insurance premium for one declared value. The quote creates no policy and charges nothing.

useCases.title: Buy a policy for a shipment after approval
useCases.text: Quote the premium first. After the user approves the premium, buy a live policy for that one shipment. Keep the policy id for any later claim.

useCases.title: File a claim on an insured shipment
useCases.text: After the user approves it, file a claim on an active policy by its id, or by tracking number. Lost and missing claims need a trace start date. Photos go in the ShipSlip dashboard.
